# LC Phone API v3 — operations

4 operations. Full request and response shapes: [reference.md](reference.md).

- `phone-system.active-numbers` — **List active numbers** — `GET /phone-system/numbers/location/{locationId}` (read, location)
  List active numbers.
- `phone-system.get-number-pool-list` — **List number pools** — `GET /phone-system/number-pools` (read, location)
  Returns number pools for the location.
- `phone-system.list-available-numbers-for-a-country` — **List available phone numbers** — `GET /phone-system/numbers/location/{locationId}/available` (read, location)
  Search Twilio inventory for purchasable phone numbers in a country for the given location.
- `phone-system.purchase-number-for-location` — **Purchase number for location** — `POST /phone-system/numbers/location/{locationId}/purchase` (write, location)
  Purchase number for location.
